title: Valid Parentheses
problem_statement: Given a string containing only brackets, determine if the input string is valid. A string is valid if every open bracket is closed by the same type of bracket in the correct order.
input_format: A single line containing the bracket string.
output_format: Print YES if valid, otherwise NO.

title: Sort Array
problem_statement: Given an array of N integers, sort them in ascending order and print the result.
input_format:
First line: N.
Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
problem_statement: Given an array of N integers, find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum and return that sum.
input_format:
First line: N (1 <= N <= 10^5).
Second line: N space-separated integers.
output_format: Print a single integer — the maximum subarray sum.

title: Activity Selection Problem
problem_statement: Given N activities with start and end times, select the maximum number of non-overlapping activities.
input_format:
First line: N.
Next N lines: start and end time of each activity.
output_format: Print a single integer — the maximum number of activities.

title: Shortest Path in Unweighted Graph
problem_statement: Given an undirected unweighted graph with N nodes and M edges, find the shortest path from node S to node D. If no path exists, print -1.
input_format:
First line: N, M, S, D.
Next M lines: two integers u and v representing an edge.
output_format: Print the shortest path length or -1.

title: Longest Common Subsequence
problem_statement: Given two strings A and B, find the length of their Longest Common Subsequence (LCS). A subsequence is derived by deleting some characters without changing the order.
input_format:
First line: string A.
Second line: string B.
output_format: Print a single integer — the length of the LCS.

title: Find Missing Number
problem_statement: An array contains N distinct integers from the range [0, N]. Exactly one number is missing. Find and return it.
input_format:
First line: N.
Second line: N space-separated integers.
